ambiguities_or_notes: The p. 138 marker, inserted 8 September heading, abbreviated internal date/location/time line, and both diary paragraphs are represented; the exact source SHA-256 matched the mounted audited Russian snapshot and the direct P003 boundary result was CLEAR.

The source reads «Овеянниково», while nearby 1894 diary entries generally read «Овсянниково». Because a place-name anomaly can signal transcription damage, this triggered SOURCE_SUSPECTED. The official volume 52 text independently confirms «Овеянниково» in this 8 September entry, so the source is verified rather than corrected; English preserves it as 'Oveyannikovo'.
«Всё начал с начала» remains 'Started everything from the beginning.' «рубил с Давыдовым» remains objectless as 'chopped with Davydov' rather than supplying 'wood' from context.
«Всё хорошо, но она скучная» is rendered 'Everything is good, but she is boring.' The adjective is not softened to 'bored' or an explanation of Masha's mood.

«Нынче утро всё только читал и не садился за стол» is 'This morning did nothing but read and did not sit down at the table', preserving Tolstoy's explicit writing-table image rather than replacing it with 'did not work'. «условие» is rendered 'agreement' and «кое-как» remains the abrupt 'somehow'.

«жить можно только дурно — похотями» is rendered 'one can live badly only through lusts'. 'Lusts' preserves the morally charged plural «похотями» without narrowing the sentence by explaining which appetites Tolstoy means.

The positive sequence retains all three nouns: 'kindness, the desire, the effort to be kinder and kinder.' The repetition of the добр- idea is preserved rather than compressed into a generic phrase about moral improvement.

The final analogy remains close: only people with strong ideal aspirations can 'fall morally low'; only a winged bird can 'plunge headlong down'; the last fragment remains 'Consciousness of the power of spiritual ascent—wings.' rather than being completed into an explanatory sentence.

The reverse target-to-source audit found no omitted substantive phrase, no unsupported explanation, and no alteration of Tolstoy's contrast between moral height and the possibility of a correspondingly deep fall.
